The '''313th Legion''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Legion/Legends|legion]] that was active during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and vanished on the icy world of [[Ando Prime/Legends|Ando Prime]] alongside a battle droid army. The legion was commanded by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Po Bandis]]. [[Excelsior Company]], led by Commander [[Vargus]], eventually found the missing legion.
